title: rut manifest (rut.jsonc)
description: A rut module manifest: the module's identity, its entry sources, and its dependency rows. The file is JSONC — `//` and `/* */` comments and trailing commas are legal. One directory is one module; the manifest is the directory's identity card. The root module is `mod.rut` beside the manifest (file modules: `mod NAME;` in the root declares each `NAME/mod.rut` child); the `entry.lib`/`entry.libs` keys still load but are transitional.

name.description: The package name — what a `use` path spells (`use pouch::{ Vec }`). A bare package name: [a-zA-Z0-9_]+.

type.description: The package kind. `lib` is the ordinary rut package (a source body, deps allowed, no host rows). `host` is a pure declaration surface the embedding Rust binds at run time — no body, no deps of any kind. Absent means `lib`; a host package spells itself.

format.description: Marks a bundle-shaped manifest (`rut pack` needs the bundle keys; directory loading ignores them).

format_version.description: The bundle layout version (10 today). Refused on load when unknown.

entry.description: Where the module's surface and body live — relative to this manifest's directory. TRANSITIONAL: the root module is `mod.rut` beside the manifest — a manifest with no `entry.lib` takes it (file modules: `mod NAME;` declares each `NAME/mod.rut` child). The `entry.lib`/`entry.libs` keys still load but are on their way out.

type.description: The `.d.rut` declaration surface — the type half. Indexes in Decl mode.

lib.description: The body source (a `.rut` file). TRANSITIONAL: still valid, but the root module is `mod.rut` — rename the file and drop this key (file modules mount the `mod` tree beside it).

libs.description: DEPRECATED — additional body files, spliced after `lib` in listed order. File modules replace the multi-lib splice: split each file into its own `NAME/mod.rut` directory and declare `mod NAME;` in the root.

deps.description: Transitively mounted dependencies: exact specifier → descriptor. Each descriptor names exactly ONE source — `path` (a module directory) or `url` (a remote `.rutbundle`) plus, only beside `url`, the `sha256` pin. The pin is law at the mount door: the bytes mount only when their sha256 matches.

propertyNames.description: A bare package name — the specifier a `use` path spells.

peer-deps.description: Dependencies required of the consumer — never pulled transitively. Required by default; `optional: true` marks the presence-mounted kind whose integration group is the descriptor's `lib` file.

dev-deps.description: Dependencies mounted only while building/testing this package itself — never in a consumer's world. Same descriptor shape as peer-deps.

style.description: The package's formatter knobs — flat `"key": "value"` rows (e.g. `"indent": "2"`). Keys and values are validated by the `rut fmt` tool, never the loader; unknown keys ride.

namespace.description: The qualified-access head (calc's `Math`): `use calc::{ Math }` binds it and member access routes qualified (`Math.sqrt`, `Math.PI`). The surface grammar has no spelling for this — the manifest is its only form.

anyOf.description: The non-finite pair has no JSON spelling — the string names it.

consts.description: The host body's compiler-materialized constants (name → f64; calc's `Math.PI` family). The surface grammar has no `static` field form, so the manifest is their only spelling.

depDescriptor.description: Exactly one source: a `path` directory or a pinned `url` bundle — never both, never neither.

path.description: The dependency's module directory, relative to this manifest's directory (may reach outside the workspace folder).

sha256.description: The pin: 64 hex digits of the bundle's sha256 (lowercase-normalized). The pin is law at the mount door — fetched or cached bytes mount only when their hash matches; an unpinned url never mounts from the editor.

peerDescriptor.description: A peer descriptor: `path` and `lib` are strings, `optional` is the one bool.

path.description: The peer's module directory, relative to this manifest's directory. The consumer supplies the peer — the editor indexes it only when it resolves locally.

lib.description: The integration group — an impl-only `.rut` source in THIS package's directory wrapping the optional peer's types. Mounted under this package's name when the peer is present. A `.d.rut` decl surface does not gate.

optional.description: `true` marks the presence-mounted kind: the peer mounts only when the consumer's closure supplies it. Peers are required by default.
